verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for OpenHands, which offers a managed Cloud service, so the axis applies. However, no evidence documents a feature for exporting all user data in open formats. Adjacent items such as resuming conversations, rrweb browser-session recordings, serializable agent settings, and open-source self-hosting are not a documented data-export capability and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
